value.answer: That's a lot to carry, and I'm glad you reached out. If it ever gets urgent, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room. For free: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy gives free CBT for depression and anxiety, with no health card needed. You can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't right for everyone, and an intake clinician decides if you qualify. It doesn't cover crisis support or relationship counselling. For low cost in Toronto: Toronto Community Psychotherapy & Counselling Centre offers free counselling through an income-based application, though that info is about 14 months old. Student-intern clinics run about $50 a session, and Fika is $65 online only. I can't confirm any of these are taking new clients right now, and those prices may have changed.
